import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(file_path="data.csv", columns=["A", "B", "C"]):
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

    # Convert numeric columns to floats where possible.
    for col in df.columns:
        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):
            df[col] = df[col].astype(float)
        else:
            converted = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")
            if converted.notna().sum() == df[col].notna().sum() and df[col].notna().any():
                df[col] = converted.astype(float)

    plot_columns = [col for col in columns if col in df.columns]
    if not plot_columns:
        raise KeyError("None of the specified columns were found in the CSV file.")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    df[plot_columns].plot(ax=ax)
    ax.set_xlabel("Index")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.set_title("Line chart")

    selected_data = df[plot_columns].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").astype(float)
    cube_root_series = pd.Series(
        np.cbrt(selected_data.to_numpy().ravel()),
        name="cube_root",
    )

    return df, ax, cube_root_series
